purpose: Design for the four forge wrapper SKILLs that delegate document search and index updates to external backends, defining skill list, arguments, output contract and SKILL contract.
summary: Overview: forge delegates search and indexing to doc-link and doc-db backends via wrapper SKILLs
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed categories
Query flow: resolve backend order, run first available backend, no grep fallback
Query output contract: Required documents path list, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inherited-type SKILL, allowed-tools, args limited to keywords
Update flow: explicit --backend skips selection, otherwise order-list resolution
Desired state: .doc_structure.yaml is the source of truth; excluded paths are removed from index
Prerequisites: at least one backend available, judged by capability not version
Test files covering backend selection, wrappers and query isolation
tasks: Changing the Required documents output contract
Adding or changing a document search backend
Reviewing SKILL contracts for search skills
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
